Move-In Weekend.name: Move-In Weekend
Move-In Weekend.trigger: The first scene (turns 2 to 3): one quest per turn, so it follows the Ability and Pulse Tutorial seed. Update on Day 4 when the tournament is announced.

objectives.text: Settle in: unpack, choose how to spend the weekend.
Meet the housemates (Tatsuya, Mio, Shin, Sunny).
Prep for Monday: orientation at Chikara Academy, Day 3.
Create a first Ability and sign up for Pulse (Ability and Pulse Tutorial).
Enter the placement tournament as a team at Chikara Battle Arena, Days 6 to 7.
Receive a placement.

Move-In Weekend.fail: A skipped class costs -2; a tournament loss costs marks, not a place.
Move-In Weekend.standing_effect: Standing +0 to +10 from the tournament, +3 for a house cohesion moment (welcome dinner). Skipped class -2.
Move-In Weekend.seed_line: Start quest "Move-In Weekend" (giver: Sakura Lane House Manager): settle in, meet housemates, prep for Monday.
Move-In Weekend.seed_update: Update quest "Move-In Weekend": placement tournament Days 6-7 at Chikara Battle Arena; enter as a team.

Ability and Pulse Tutorial.name: Ability and Pulse Tutorial
Ability and Pulse Tutorial.trigger: Day 1, within the first scene (turn 2). Natural hook: the House Manager mentions that the house Wi-Fi, chore rota and dinner list run on Pulse, and that a housemate (Tatsuya) can help. Due before the placement tournament on Days 6 to 7.

objectives.text: Create your first Ability
Sign up for Pulse

Ability and Pulse Tutorial.success: The player character has a first Ability and a Pulse account, both entirely the player's choices.
Ability and Pulse Tutorial.fail: Not done by the placement tournament (Days 6 to 7): the character enters it with no abilities. The House Manager or Tatsuya offers help again; nothing is forced and nothing ends.
Ability and Pulse Tutorial.seed_line: Start quest "Ability and Pulse Tutorial" (giver: House Manager): create your first Ability, then sign up for Pulse; the house Wi-Fi and lists run on it.
Ability and Pulse Tutorial.notes: Player-directed only. The sign_up_pulse objective stays hidden until create_ability is done. Never invent the character's ability concept, account or consent; explain how ability creation and Pulse sign-up work if asked. Characters start with no abilities, so this must happen before the placement tournament on Days 6 to 7. Lookups: db.py lore --full dynamic-ability-damage-system, ability-progression-structure and social-phone-and-friend-groups.

Midterm Marks.name: Midterm Marks
Midterm Marks.trigger: The first specialization class, Day 10 (Monday of week 2).

objectives.text: Attend specialization classes.
Take a part-time job (WorkLink Exchange/job-board) or join a club.
Take part in the joint 1A/2B field exercise, Day 34, Hero Field Complex/rescue-village.
Attend the midterm progress review, Day 42, Chikara Academy/main-hall.

Midterm Marks.fail: Skipped classes -2 each; a disciplinary incident -5; a public scandal -5. Shimazu still tells 2B it is failing at the review.
Midterm Marks.standing_effect: +2 per good week; +3 to +5 for public rescues or good conduct in the field exercise. Skipped classes -2 each; disciplinary incident -5; public scandal -5.
Midterm Marks.seed_line: Start quest "Midterm Marks" (giver: Kenji Arimura): attend specialization classes, find a job or club, join the Day 34 field exercise, face the Day 42 review.

Cracks in the House.name: Cracks in the House
Cracks in the House.trigger: After the midterm (Day 43), when the house is quiet and strained.

objectives.text: Find out what is wrong with the house, starting with who is carrying a weight.
Decide how to handle it: help, confront, hide, or report.
Protect the house if trouble comes to the door.
Face Shimazu's inquiry.

Cracks in the House.success: The house survives the crisis intact, whichever path is chosen. Standing per path (see arc-bible.md and the ledger rubric).
Cracks in the House.fail: A path left unresolved lets the collection contract go live on Day 61; the next fight happens on worse terms. Theft discovered -25. An off-books fight -5.
Cracks in the House.standing_effect: Per path: see ledger rubric act3_path_effects. Theft discovered -25; off-books fight -5.
Cracks in the House.seed_line: Start quest "Cracks in the House" (giver: Sakura Lane House Manager): something is wearing on the house; find out what, and decide what to do about it.
Cracks in the House.notes: The Manager opens with: "Something is wearing on this house."

Final Review.name: Final Review

objectives.text: Learn the Battle Test pairs (Day 80).
Train with Arimura through weeks 12 to 14.
Take the Battle Test (separate quest).
Attend the final review, Day 112, Chikara Academy/main-hall.

Final Review.success: The review is held; the ending is set by Standing (70+ Renewed, 40 to 69 Probation, under 40 Dissolved). The +15 integrity credit applies for a confession.
Final Review.fail: No failure; the ending changes. Dissolved still gives a move-out epilogue.
Final Review.standing_effect: Ending thresholds: 70+ Renewed, 40-69 Probation, under 40 Dissolved. Apply the +15 confession credit first.
Final Review.seed_line: Start quest "Final Review" (giver: Kenji Arimura): the semester ends in the Battle Test and a Day 112 review by Vice Principal Shimazu; train and prepare.

Gentle Hands.name: Gentle Hands
Gentle Hands.trigger: A player character reaches relationship 50 or more with Tatsuya. Other player characters may join if present or invited.

objectives.text: Learn why he apologizes, and what happened at the gym wall.
Test small, controlled releases at Hero Field Complex/field-complex.
Build a safe "bleed-off" (plates or a shock sink; Mio can help; a spotter such as Yūto or Arimura).
Make the full release at the gym wall he broke, Chikara Battle Arena/training-bays.

Gentle Hands.success: The full release is controlled and the wall holds (or comes down deliberately). A reliable big move for the Battle Test.
Gentle Hands.fail: It stays open. Tatsuya keeps leaking; furniture cracks.
Gentle Hands.seed_line: Start quest "Gentle Hands" (giver: Tatsuya Ōmine): find a safe way for Tatsuya to fully release his power; it ends at the gym wall he broke.
Gentle Hands.notes: Personal quest (Tatsuya). Giver location is maple-bedroom or shared-kitchen.

Built, Not Born.name: Built, Not Born
Built, Not Born.trigger: A player character reaches relationship 50 or more with Mio. Works whether or not the secret comes out.

objectives.text: See her sketches and hear what she wants to build.
Source parts at Support Street/prototype-studio and Gearshift Support Shop/inventory-room.
Build and bench-test the control gauntlet.
Field-test it at Hero Field Complex/mobility-track.

Built, Not Born.success: Legitimate control gear of her own (a stabilizer gauntlet); ties into the retest (makes a pass natural).
Built, Not Born.fail: It stays open. If the fraud comes out, her retest is harder.
Built, Not Born.standing_effect: Standing +3 (cohesion) if it is shared with the house.
Built, Not Born.seed_line: Start quest "Built, Not Born" (giver: Mio Tachibana): help Mio build control gear of her own, from parts to field test.

Old Corners.name: Old Corners
Old Corners.trigger: A player character reaches relationship 50 or more with Shin.

objectives.text: Learn why Shin has gone quiet (a message from the old gang).
Go with him to Kurokawa District/backstreet-crossroads, where the Nine Corners want him for one job.
Decide whom Shin trusts: a player, Yūto, Arimura, or no one.
Resolve the job: refuse, foil it, or redirect it.

Old Corners.success: The old boss releases him, or Shin walks away with the house behind him; a clean break.
Old Corners.fail: It stays open; the gang tries again. A public scandal -5.
Old Corners.standing_effect: Standing +3 for good conduct if the job is stopped without scandal; public scandal -5.
Old Corners.seed_line: Start quest "Old Corners" (giver: Shin Asakura): Shin's old gang wants him for one job; decide who he can trust.
Old Corners.notes: Personal quest (Shin). Giver location is rooftop-chill-deck or the entrance step (building-entrance).

Off-Camera.name: Off-Camera
Off-Camera.trigger: A player character reaches relationship 50 or more with Sunny.

objectives.text: Learn what the scandal video really was, and why she deflects.
Find the unedited footage (Pulse Media Tower/press-room or Power Practice Studio/practice-floor).
Learn what the footage shows: she took the blame for Ayame.
Settle things with Ayame, privately (Chikara Academy/north-rooftop-overlook) or at the Battle Test.

Off-Camera.success: Sunny chooses (expose, forgive, or let it go) and Ayame chooses whether to own it.
Off-Camera.fail: It stays open; the clip resurfaces. A public scandal -5.
Off-Camera.standing_effect: Standing +3 to +5 for good conduct if handled well; public scandal -5.
Off-Camera.seed_line: Start quest "Off-Camera" (giver: Park Seo-yeon "Sunny"): find the truth behind Sunny's scandal video and settle things with Ayame.
Off-Camera.notes: Personal quest (Sunny). Giver location is rooftop-chill-deck or sunrise-bedroom.

The Lab Job.name: The Lab Job
The Lab Job.trigger: Around Day 52, when Mio's broker message reaches the players (Mio brings it to them, or a player sees it).

objectives.text: Learn what the job is: steal the Lantern Coil from the Support lab, Chikara Academy/classroom-5a, to clear Mio's debt.
Decide: accept, refuse, or stall (deadline Day 60).
If accepted: scout the lab, get in, take the Coil, hand it off at Riverside Green/riverside-bridge.

The Lab Job.fail: Refuse or stall: the collection contract goes live on Day 61; collectors hit the house (see "Cracks in the House").
The Lab Job.standing_effect: Accept and succeed: Standing -25 if the theft is discovered (it might never be).
The Lab Job.seed_line: Start quest "The Lab Job" (giver: Sōichi Tamaru): a broker offers to clear a debt in exchange for taking a prototype from the Support lab; answer by Day 60.
The Lab Job.notes: Nightshade job offer. Tamaru gives it through the Nightshade app; in person at Nightshade Exchange Relay/contract-room if the players go.

Retest.name: Retest
Retest.trigger: The fraud comes out: a confession, a theft discovery, or a Nightshade leak. Within seven days; no later than Day 98. Default Day 84.

objectives.text: Prepare: help Mio study, build, practice (at least two meaningful prep beats).
Sit the supervised retest: Mio builds a working tool from standard stock and uses Exploded View, steady and without the rig, to free a mock casualty from a jammed door.

Retest.success: Mio stays at Chikara Academy and in 2B.
Retest.fail: Mio is removed (transferred out); this feeds the Probation ending. Fail only if prep was absent and the in-scene puzzle goes unsolved.
Retest.seed_line: Start quest "Retest" (giver: Reiko Shimazu): Mio must pass a supervised retest of her control, with her real power and her own gear, before the Battle Test; help her prepare.
Retest.notes: Mio's retest. Arimura supervises with Shimazu.

Battle Test.name: Battle Test

objectives.text: Learn your pair (players pair with each other; odd player with Sunny).
Train with Arimura (Hero Field Complex/mobility-track).
Walk the site (Hero Field Complex/field-complex).
On Day 105: evacuate civilians from the simulated collapsing transit station, handle the proctor threats, and respond to the second collapse. Help other pairs, including 1A.

Battle Test.seed_line: Start quest "Battle Test" (giver: Reiko Shimazu): paired training for the Day 105 Battle Test at Hero Field Complex; evacuate civilians and help other pairs.
Battle Test.notes: Act 4 showcase. Test held at Hero Field Complex (rescue-village), judged from the observation-tower.
